# rpc

```go
import "github.com/kitsunium/sdk/pkg/v1/proc/ipc/rpc"
```

Package rpc is a call between two processes of one machine over the private socket of proc/ipc (ADR 0218): a request and its reply, or a request and the items a server pushes, framed, bounded and encoded in a codec format both ends agreed on.

```
srv, err := rpc.NewServer(rpc.ServerConfig{
	Formats: []codec.Format{"json"}, MaxFrameBytes: 1 << 20,
	MaxInFlight: 64, FrameTimeout: 5 * time.Second,
}, rpc.Methods{"status": rpc.HandlerFunc(status)})
go srv.Serve(ln) // ln from ipc.Listen

c, err := rpc.NewClient(ctx, dialer, rpc.ClientConfig{
	Format: "json", MaxFrameBytes: 1 << 20, MaxInFlight: 64,
	FrameTimeout: 5 * time.Second, CallTimeout: 2 * time.Second,
})
err = c.Call(ctx, "status", req, &resp)
```

A format is a codec registered under its name: import the codec's package (pkg/v1/data/codec/json, say) for it to be there.

### Bounds, every one the caller's

A frame longer than MaxFrameBytes is refused on its length, before a byte of its body is read or allocated ([CodeFrameTooLarge](#CodeFrameTooLarge)); one not whole within FrameTimeout of its first byte closes the connection. At most MaxInFlight calls run per connection, the next answered [CodeOverloaded](#CodeOverloaded) at once. A call carries its deadline to the server, which ends the handler's context on it; a caller that gives up sends a cancel frame ([CodeCallTimeout](#CodeCallTimeout), [CodeCallCancelled](#CodeCallCancelled)). None of these bounds has a default: zero is refused ([CodeMisconfigured](#CodeMisconfigured)).

### Errors across the socket

A handler's error carrying an SDK code reaches the caller with that code, reason and public text, so errs.HasCode works on both sides; any other error is [CodeRemoteFailed](#CodeRemoteFailed) there, its text kept on the server.

```go
type Caller interface {
	// Call sends in to method and decodes the reply into out (nil drops it),
	// within ctx: CALL_TIMEOUT or CALL_CANCELLED when ctx, or the caller's own
	// bound, ends first; the server's refusals keep their code.

	// Stream sends in to method and returns the items the server sends back,
	// until their end, ctx's or the stream's Close.
	Stream(ctx context.Context, method string, in any) (Stream, error)
}
```

<a name="Client.Call"></a>
### func \(Client\) [Call](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/proc/ipc/rpc/client.go>)

```go
func (*Client) Call(ctx context.Context, method string, in any, out any) error
```

Call sends in to method and decodes the reply into out (nil drops it). It waits for ctx and for CallTimeout on the client's clock, whichever ends first: past either the server is sent a cancel frame and the call is CALL\_TIMEOUT or CALL\_CANCELLED. The server's own refusals keep their code.


<a name="Client.Stream"></a>
### func \(Client\) [Stream](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/proc/ipc/rpc/stream.go>)

```go
func (*Client) Stream(ctx context.Context, method string, in any) (corerpc.Stream, error)
```

Stream sends in to method and returns the items the server sends back, until its end, ctx's or Close. Its items are bounded by MaxFrameBytes as any frame; a reader slower than the server holds the connection's other calls behind it, so a long stream wants a client of its own.

## type [ClientConfig](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/pkg/v1/proc/ipc/rpc/gen_facade.go>)

ClientConfig is how a client speaks and how long it waits.

```go
type ClientConfig = svcrpc.ClientConfig
```

ClientConfig is an alias of `github.com/kitsunium/sdk/internal/service/proc/ipc/rpc.ClientConfig`, declared as:

```go
type ClientConfig struct {
	// Format is the body format, by the name a codec is registered under.
	Format        codec.Format
	// MaxFrameBytes is the longest frame the client reads, checked on the
	// length before anything is read; the server is told it in the hello.
	MaxFrameBytes int
	// MaxInFlight is how many calls and streams the client keeps open at once;
	// the next is OVERLOADED, before a byte is sent.
	MaxInFlight   int
	// FrameTimeout is how long a frame may take, from its first byte to its
	// last, read or written; past it the connection is closed.
	FrameTimeout  time.Duration
	// CallTimeout is the longest a Call or a Ping waits, on Clock, when its
	// context allows longer; a Stream lives as long as its context.
	CallTimeout   time.Duration
	// Clock times the frames and the calls; nil is clock.System.
	Clock         clock.Timed
}
```

Handler answers the calls of one method: ServeRPC(ctx, req) returns the reply, or sends a Stream's items through req.Send.

```go

```

Handler is an alias of `github.com/kitsunium/sdk/internal/core/proc/ipc/rpc.Handler`, declared as:

```go
type Handler interface {
	// ServeRPC answers one call. ctx ends when the caller cancels, its deadline
	// passes on the server's clock, or the connection closes; context.Cause
	// says which. A Call is answered with reply, encoded in the connection's
	// format; a Stream with the items req.Send wrote, then its end — and reply,
	// when not nil, as one last item. An error carrying an SDK code reaches the
	// caller with that code, reason and public text; any other is REMOTE_FAILED
	// there, its text kept on this side.
	ServeRPC(ctx context.Context, req Request) (reply any, err error)
}
```

```go
	// Decode decodes the call's body into v with the connection's format;
	// CODEC_FAILED when it does not decode.

}
```

<a name="Server.Serve"></a>
### func \(Server\) [Serve](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/proc/ipc/rpc/server.go>)

```go
func (*Server) Serve(ln coreipc.Listener) error
```

Serve accepts ln's connections and serves each in a goroutine until ln is closed, or the server is, then waits for those goroutines: it returns nil after Close, the listener's error otherwise.

Goroutine lifecycle: one per accepted connection, running ServeConn; each ends with its connection — the peer's hang-up, a violation, or Close, which ends them all — and Serve returns only once every one has.

<a name="Server.ServeConn"></a>
### func \(Server\) [ServeConn](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/internal/service/proc/ipc/rpc/server.go>)

```go
func (*Server) ServeConn(ctx context.Context, c *coreipc.Conn) error
```

ServeConn serves one connection until it ends, ctx ends or the server is closed, closes it, and returns once its handlers have — every handler's context ends with the connection. A peer that broke the protocol is the error, so is a frame past MaxFrameBytes; a peer that hung up is nil.

```go
	// method and body — checked on the length before anything is read.
	MaxFrameBytes int
	// MaxInFlight is how many calls run at once on one connection; the next is
	// OVERLOADED.
	MaxInFlight   int
	// FrameTimeout is how long a frame may take, from its first byte to its
	// last, read or written; past it the connection is closed.
	FrameTimeout  time.Duration
	// Clock times the frames and the calls' budgets; nil is clock.System.
	Clock         clock.Timed
}
```

<a name="Stream"></a>
## type [Stream](<https://github.com/kitsunium/sdk/blob/main/pkg/v1/proc/ipc/rpc/gen_facade.go>)

Stream is a server's items, read with Recv until it reports false.

```go
type Stream = corerpc.Stream
```

Stream is an alias of `github.com/kitsunium/sdk/internal/core/proc/ipc/rpc.Stream`, declared as:

```go
type Stream interface {
	// Close abandons the stream: the server is sent a cancel frame for it and
	// the items still on the way are dropped. It is idempotent.
	Close() error
	// Recv decodes the next item into v and reports true; at the stream's end it
	// reports false and a nil error. The server's error, a cancelled context, a
	// deadline or a closed connection end it with that error.
	Recv(v any) (more bool, err error)
}
```
